# Instructions

## Business context

This project is an Angular frontend for a non-profit. The visuals are the main focus and the website should be appealling.

## Technical context

The main pages (the ones that are used in the <router-outlet></router-outlet>) are located in src/app/components/pages.

The reusable components are located in src/app/components/subcomponents.

The project uses Angular Material, the stylyng should be consistent and lie upon Angular Material.

The typescript files are always named in kebab-case.

Never use older controls like *ngIf, use the new @if, @else, ...
